b2-01-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Worried You?
b2-01-01.scenario: At the station in Sárszeg, a neighbour asks Antónia (you) why she is so quiet after Pacsirta's train left. You explain that it is the silence, not the train, that causes your anxiety.
b2-01-01.prompt: Tell the neighbour what causes your anxiety.
b2-01-01.target: Nem a vonat, hanem a csend okozza a szorongásomat.
b2-01-01.english: It is not the train, but the silence that causes my anxiety.
b2-01-01.canDo: I can identify the pre-verbal focus slot in Hungarian narrative sentences.

b2-01-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Broke the Silence?
b2-01-02.scenario: At lunch, Antónia asks Ákos (you) whether he spoke first after Pacsirta left. You say it was not you but Antónia who broke the silence.
b2-01-02.prompt: Tell Antónia who broke the silence.
cues: Say that it was not you
b2-01-02.target: Nem én törtem meg a csendet, hanem te.
b2-01-02.english: It was not I who broke the silence, but you.
b2-01-02.canDo: I can invert preverbs (meg-, el-, ki-, be-, rá-) when another constituent occupies the focus slot.

b2-01-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Sides of One Day
b2-01-03.scenario: A neighbour asks Ákos (you) how Pacsirta and her parents spent the evening. You explain that Pacsirta does not like music, but you and Antónia enjoyed the theatre.
b2-01-03.prompt: Contrast Pacsirta with you and Antónia for the neighbour.
cues: Say what Pacsirta does not like
Contrast it with your own feeling
b2-01-03.target: Pacsirta nem szereti a zenét, mi viszont nagyon szerettük a színházat.
b2-01-03.english: Pacsirta does not like music; we, however, liked the theatre very much.
b2-01-03.canDo: I can frame contrastive topics using 'ami X-et illeti', 'viszont', and 'ezzel szemben'.

b2-01-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Only for Her Sake
b2-01-04.scenario: A friend asks Ákos (you) why you and Antónia gave up the theatre for years. You say it was solely for Pacsirta's sake.
b2-01-04.prompt: Tell your friend why you gave up the theatre.
cues: Say it was only for one person
b2-01-04.target: Kizárólag Pacsirta kedvéért mondtunk le a színházról.
b2-01-04.english: We gave up the theatre solely for Pacsirta's sake.
b2-01-04.canDo: I can use exclusivity particles ('csak', 'éppen', 'kizárólag') to narrow narrative focus.

b2-01-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Quiet Evening
b2-01-05.scenario: In the dark bedroom, Antónia asks Ákos (you) when you first felt free that day. You say that only at the restaurant did you realise it, and that you did not say it aloud.
b2-01-05.prompt: Tell Antónia when you realised you felt free, and that you said nothing.
cues: Say that you did not say it
b2-01-05.target: Csak a vendéglőben döbbentem rá. Egyetlen szóval sem mondtam el.
b2-01-05.english: Only in the restaurant did I realise it. Not with a single word did I say it.
b2-01-05.canDo: I can read a short literary scene and notice which word stands before the verb.

b2-01-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: What Did the Neighbours See?
b2-01-consolidation.scenario: A neighbour asks Antónia (you) whether people saw you laughing in the restaurant. You say it was not the laughing they noticed but your new dress.
b2-01-consolidation.prompt: Tell the neighbour what people noticed.
cues: Say what they did not notice
b2-01-consolidation.target: Nem a nevetést vették észre a vendéglőben, hanem az új ruhámat.
b2-01-consolidation.english: They did not notice the laughing in the restaurant, but my new dress.
b2-01-consolidation.canDo: I can recognize and interpret pre-verbal focus and preverb-verb inversion across B2 literary passages.
